TEXT.citation: Gravius, Daniël. 1661. Het Heylige Evangelium Matthei en Johannis ofte Hagnau Ka D'llig Matiktik. Ka na sasoulat ti Mattheus, ti Johannes appa. Overgeset inde Formosaansche tale, voor de Inwoonders van Soulang, Mattau, Sinckan, Bacloan, Tavocan en Tevorang. Amsterdam: Michiel Hartogh.

S.FORM: Ka ni-akoumea ta ta'u ka na Farisëen, ka ti Ni-kodemus ta nanang tyn, ka Sih-bavau ki Joden.
S.TRANSL: There was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews:
有一個法利賽人，名叫尼哥德慕，是猶太人的官。

S.FORM: Teni ta ni-iroua ka euvanan mou-qua ti Jesus-an, ka ni-koun tyn tyni-æn, Rabbi, kavana'ni-en ka Tama-Mahtæutæuugh-kow ka ni-makka-qua ki Alid: alei ka assi pa-'lpouh ta ti-mamang pa-mut ki pou-kidi-en k'atta ka pam't-en-hou-ra, dou assi tou lam tyni-æn ta Alid.
S.TRANSL: The same came to Jesus by night, and said unto him, Rabbi, we know that thou art a teacher come from God: for no man can do these miracles that thou doest, except God be with him.
這人夜裏來見耶穌，說：「拉比，我們知道你是由上帝那裏來作師傅的；因為你所行的神蹟，若沒有上帝同在，無人能行。」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus ka ni-k'ma tyni-æn, Missing, missing koun-au-kow, Heirou assi pei-la-en mei-alak ta ti-mamang, as-si kmi-'lpouh kmytta ta teni ki Pei-sasou-an ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered and said unto him, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God.
耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你，人若不重生，就不能見上帝的國。」

S.FORM: Ni-k'ma ta ti Nikodemus tyni-æn; Pei-lpough-au-lato mei-alak ta ka'euloung mamei-mang [rou] mamou-ato ta teni? Mou-'lpouh kaua mouh-pouhal mou-vouijl ki dena tyn, ka pei-la-auh mei-alak?
S.TRANSL: Nicodemus saith unto him, How can a man be born when he is old? can he enter the second time into his mother's womb, and be born?
尼哥德慕說：「人已經老了，如何能重生呢？豈能再進母腹生出來嗎？」

S.FORM: Ni-pattæ'i-vli-en ti Jesus, Missing, missing koun-au-kow; Rou assi pei-alak-in ta ti-mamang ki raloum ki Joep-an, assi tyn 'ou-'lpouh-in mou-rbo tou Pei-sasou-an ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered, Verily, verily, I say unto thee, Except a man be born of water and of the Spirit, he cannot enter into the kingdom of God.
耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你，人若不是從水和聖靈生的，就不能進上帝的國。

S.FORM: Ka ni-pei-alak ki vât, vât ta anna: pei-alak ki Joep-an, Joep-an ta anna.
S.TRANSL: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
從肉身生的就是肉身；從靈生的就是靈。

S.FORM: In-â mou-ryng-hau ka ni-vana-en-au kow, Kidi-ato ka pei-la-auh-kamou mei-alak ta ym-ou-mi-ra.
S.TRANSL: Marvel not that I said unto thee, Ye must be born again.
我說：『你們必須重生』，你不要以為希奇。

S.FORM: Bavarè ta varè tou ma-mang ka kâmoei-in tyn, ka 'illingig-en-hou ta harimhim tyn, ra assi 'mou-hou 'ou-mhân ka makka-kouna ka sah-kakoun-ah ta anna: kma-hyna ta mai-boävoual ka pei-alak ki Joep-an.
S.TRANSL: The wind bloweth where it listeth, and thou hearest the sound thereof, but canst not tell whence it cometh, and whither it goeth: so is every one that is born of the Spirit.
風隨着意思吹，你聽見風的響聲，卻不曉得從哪裏來，往哪裏去；凡從聖靈生的，也是如此。」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Niko-demus k'ma tyni-æn; Pa-ilpoug-hen pamut ta mamang k'atta mame'imang?
S.TRANSL: Nicodemus answered and said unto him, How can these things be?
尼哥德慕問他說：「怎能有這事呢？」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Jesus ka ni k'ma tyni-æn; Mahtatæu-tæuuh kow kaua tou Israel ka kauro-en-appa-'mhou ta atta-ra?
S.TRANSL: Jesus answered and said unto him, Art thou a master of Israel, and knowest not these things?
耶穌回答說：「你是以色列人的先生，還不明白這事嗎？

S.FORM: Missing, missing koun-au kow, ka kavanân-niæn ta pa-sasoun-ni-æn, ka ni-k'yttan-niæn ta pa-ttæi-hail-nian, ka assi-mou-mi atta-rarijh-en ta pattæ'i-hail-niæn-da.
S.TRANSL: Verily, verily, I say unto thee, We speak that we do know, and testify that we have seen; and ye receive not our witness.
我實實在在地告訴你，我們所說的是我們知道的；我們所見證的是我們見過的；你們卻不領受我們的見證。

S.FORM: Heirou ni-pa-sousou-en-au-kamou ki makka-næi, ka assi moumi tna-'msing, tna-'msing-ah-kamou mame'i-mang, rou pasousou-en-au-kamou ki makka tounnoun.
S.TRANSL: If I have told you earthly things, and ye believe not, how shall ye believe, if I tell you of heavenly things?
我對你們說地上的事，你們尚且不信，若說天上的事，如何能信呢？

S.FORM: Ka assi ni-sa-bavau sah-tounnoun ta ti-mamang, dyk ty-ni-æn ka ni-mourarum makka tounnoun, [teni] ta Alak ki kæ'euloung ka æ'ia-tounnoun.
S.TRANSL: And no man hath ascended up to heaven, but he that came down from heaven, even the Son of man which is in heaven.
除了從天降下、仍舊在天的人子，沒有人升過天。

S.FORM: Ka mama ka ni-pou-va-vau-in ti Moses tou peu-læ-pou-Iæh ta voeley, kidi-ato ka pou-va-vau-auh kma-hynna ta Alak ki kæ'eulong.
S.TRANSL: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of man be lifted up:
摩西在曠野怎樣舉蛇，人子也必照樣被舉起來，

S.FORM: Alei ka assi tau-rumma-ah ta mei-bovoel ka tna-'msing tyni-æn ka akoume-âl-appa ki kæua'g-han ka myhkaqua myddaryn-nouh.
S.TRANSL: That whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have eternal life.
叫一切信他的都得永生。

S.FORM: Ka ni-kævæ'ango-en kma-hynna ki Alid ta næy, ka ni-phæ'n tyn ta Alak tyn ka Pei-sât-an, alei k'assi tau-rumma-ah ta mei-bovoel ka tna-'msing tyni-æn, ka a-koume-âl-appa ki kæu'ag'-han ka myh-kaqua myddarynnouh.
S.TRANSL: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son, that whosoever believeth in him should not perish, but have everlasting life.
「上帝愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給他們，叫一切信他的，不致滅亡，反得永生。

S.FORM: Nda ka assi ni-pa-din-gi-en ki Alid ta Alak tyn tou næi alei ka dungdung-auh tyn ta næi, alei-appa ka pakariang-auh tyn ta næi alei tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: For God sent not his Son into the world to condemn the world; but that the world through him might be saved.
因為上帝差他的兒子降世，不是要定世人的罪，乃是要叫世人因他得救。

S.FORM: Ty-mang ta tna-'msing tyni-æn, assi dungdung-auh, ra ti-mang ta assi tna-'msing kah-'an-ato hnyn dmungdung: alei ka assi ni-tna-'msing tou Nanang ki Alak ki Alid ka Pei-saät-en.
S.TRANSL: He that believeth on him is not condemned: but he that believeth not is condemned already, because he hath not believed in the name of the only begotten Son of God.
信他的人，不被定罪；不信的人，罪已經定了，因為他不信上帝獨生子的名。

S.FORM: Ka att'-appa ta dungdung-un, ka irou-ato ta ræmæh tou Nai, ka ni-kasaoun-nun ma-væängö ki kaeuloung ta karum-dum-man, ki ræmæh: alei ka mat-ë ta na ringei nein-nda.
S.TRANSL: And this is the condemnation, that light is come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
光來到世間，世人因自己的行為是惡的，不愛光，倒愛黑暗，定他們的罪就是在此。

S.FORM: Ka ti-mamang ka pamut ki kat-'è-en, 'æ'æs-in tyn ta ræ-mæh, ka assi mou-qua tou ræmæh ta teni, alei ka assi patym'h'eil'a-to ta na ringei tyn.
S.TRANSL: For every one that doeth evil hateth the light, neither cometh to the light, lest his deeds should be reproved.
凡作惡的便恨光，並不來就光，恐怕他的行為受責備。

S.FORM: . Ra ti-mamang ta pamut ki katiktik-an ki sou, mou-qua tou ræmæh ta teni, ki paka-æmæ'-euh ta na ringei tyn, alei ka ni-pa-mut tou Alilid-den.
S.TRANSL: But he that doeth truth cometh to the light, that his deeds may be made manifest, that they are wrought in God.
但行真理的必來就光，要顯明他所行的是靠上帝而行。」

S.FORM: Si-æ̈-'uh ki anna ni-iroua ta ti Jesus, ki Pahtatæutæuæu-han-appa tyn mou-qua tou pourogh ki Judæä ka ni-malanga ta teni hynna lam neini-æn, meu-læu'u-lough-da.
S.TRANSL: After these things came Jesus and his disciples into the land of Judaea; and there he tarried with them, and baptized.
這事以後，耶穌和門徒到了猶太地，在那裏居住，施洗。

S.FORM: Ka ni-m'æuloug-appa ta ti Johannes tou Enon tou tamang ki Salim, alei ka madagh hynna ta raloum: ka ni-iroua mou-qua hynna, ka ni-uloug-han-atou-ra.
S.TRANSL: And John also was baptizing in Aenon near to Salim, because there was much water there: and they came, and were baptized.
約翰在靠近撒冷的哀嫩也施洗；因為那裏水多，眾人都去受洗。（

S.FORM: Ka assi-appa pou-sang-at-tin ta ti Joannes.
S.TRANSL: For John was not yet cast into prison.
那時約翰還沒有下在監裏。）

S.FORM: Anna ta ni-æhpit ta pa-tig-til-lan ki sou ki Pæhtæutæu-han ti Joannes lam-appa ki Joden alei ki paka-kouptyg-han.
S.TRANSL: Then there arose a question between some of John's disciples and the Jews about purifying.
約翰的門徒和一個猶太人辯論潔淨的禮，

S.FORM: Ka ni-mou-qua ti Joan-nes-an, ka ni-koun nein tyni-æn; Rabbi, teni ka na lam-ohou tou arouh ki Jordaan, ka ni-pattæ'i-hail-en-hou tyni-æn, k'ytt-ei, mæ'u-lulouh ta teni, ka mou-ym-mud tyni-æn mou-qua.
S.TRANSL: And they came unto John, and said unto him, Rabbi, he that was with thee beyond Jordan, to whom thou barest witness, behold, the same baptizeth, and all men come to him.
就來見約翰，說：「拉比，從前同你在約旦河外、你所見證的那位，現在施洗，眾人都往他那裏去了。」

S.FORM: Ni-mattæ'i-vli ta ti Joan-nes, ka ni-k'ma-hynna, Assi a-lpough-en mara ta kaeulong ki mamang, rou assi ni-phæn tyni-æn makka tounnoun ki vullum.
S.TRANSL: John answered and said, A man can receive nothing, except it be given him from heaven.
約翰說：「若不是從天上賜的，人就不能得甚麼。

S.FORM: Tama-hail-kamou jau-an ta ymoumi mamado, ka ni-pasousou-en-au, Assi ti jau ta ti Chri-stus, ra ni-pa-dingi-en-koh pa-si-ouro tyni-æn.
S.TRANSL: Ye yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but that I am sent before him.
我曾說：『我不是基督，是奉差遣在他前面的』，你們自己可以給我作見證。

S.FORM: Ti-mang ta akou-Ina ka væ'æu, teni ta Paræh ka væ'æu: nda diou ka Paræh ka væ'æu ka mi-touhko millingigh tyni-æn, ta marai-ja ki karai-jan ki ryh, alei ki yngau ki Pæræh ka væ'æu. Anna ta pa-katmoei-en-ato ta karai-jen-au k'atta.
S.TRANSL: He that hath the bride is the bridegroom: but the friend of the bridegroom, which standeth and heareth him, rejoiceth greatly because of the bridegroom's voice: this my joy therefore is fulfilled.
娶新婦的就是新郎；新郎的朋友站着，聽見新郎的聲音就甚喜樂。故此，我這喜樂滿足了。

S.FORM: Kidi ka tou saoun-ah kæuh-irang ta teni, ra l'auaeih-koh ta ti jau.
S.TRANSL: He must increase, but I must decrease.
他必興旺，我必衰微。」

S.FORM: Teni ka makka-vavau, itou ymmid itou vavau: Te-ni ka makka-qua ki næi, mak-ka næi ta teni, ka pa-sousou-en tyn ta atou næi. Teni ka makka-tounnoun ki vullum, si-bavau ta teni ki ymmid.
S.TRANSL: He that cometh from above is above all: he that is of the earth is earthly, and speaketh of the earth: he that cometh from heaven is above all.
「從天上來的是在萬有之上；從地上來的是屬乎地，他所說的也是屬乎地。從天上來的是在萬有之上。

S.FORM: Ka na kak'ytta tyn ka na'il-lalingig tyn, pattæ'i-hail-lun tyn ma-sousou ta anna: ka assi pæh-ba-lei matta-rijh sasasat ka ti-maman ki pattæ'i-hail-en-tyn-da.
S.TRANSL: And what he hath seen and heard, that he testifieth; and no man receiveth his testimony.
他將所見所聞的見證出來，只是沒有人領受他的見證。

S.FORM: Timang ta ni-pæh-balei matta-rijh ki pattæ'i-hail-en tyn, ni-pou-tapoejou pou-shut ka ma-tiktik ki sou ta Alid.
S.TRANSL: He that hath received his testimony hath set to his seal that God is true.
那領受他見證的，就印上印，證明上帝是真的。

S.FORM: Nda ti-mang ta ni-padin-gi-en ki Alid, pa-sousou-en tyn ta sou ki Alid, ka assi phæn ki Alid [tyni-æn] ta J-oep-an tou pou-kakidien rih-pung.
S.TRANSL: For he whom God hath sent speaketh the words of God: for God giveth not the Spirit by measure unto him.
上帝所差來的就說上帝的話，因為上帝賜聖靈給他是沒有限量的。

S.FORM: Mavæ'angö ta Rama ki Alak, ka ni-pæ̈'æ̈-ymd-an ta ma-mang pi-'æ tou rima tyn.
S.TRANSL: The Father loveth the Son, and hath given all things into his hand.
父愛子，已將萬有交在他手裏。

S.FORM: Ti-mang ta tna-'msing ki Alak akoume'-ato ki keu'æhan ka myhkaqua myddarynnouh: Ra ti-mang ta assi miligh ki Alak, assi kmytt-ah ta teni ki kæu'æ-han: ra mæ-ijli misasaoun tou ha-lap tyni-æn ta ngale ki Alid.
S.TRANSL: He that believeth on the Son hath everlasting life: and he that believeth not the Son shall not see life; but the wrath of God abideth on him.
信子的人有永生；不信子的人得不着永生，上帝的震怒常在他身上。」
